-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.InvPbLog` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def entsPts (s : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ls, ownSlice s ls dq ∗ [∗list] l;e ∈ ls;es, entRO l e)

theorem entsPts_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (s : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) :
    entsPts s dq es ⊢ |==> entsRO s es

theorem smOpt_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) :
    smOpt p dq md ⊢ |==> smOpt p DFrac.discard md

theorem entsRO_persistent (s : GoSlice) (es : List EntryM) : Persistent (entsRO s es)

theorem entsBig_drop [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : Nat) (ls : List Loc) (es : List EntryM) :
    ([∗list] l;e ∈ ls;es, entRO l e) ⊢ [∗list] l;e ∈ List.drop n ls;List.drop n es, entRO l e

theorem hsRO_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (h1 h2 : HardStateM) : hsRO p h1 ∗ hsRO p
    h2 ⊢ ⌜h1 = h2⌝

theorem entsBig_take [package_sem : Assumptions] (n : Nat) (ls : List Loc) (es : List EntryM) :
    ([∗list] l;e ∈ ls;es, entRO l e) ⊢ [∗list] l;e ∈ List.take n ls;List.take n es, entRO l e

def ownSnapE (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : SnapshotM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ds pm uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HD" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Data" p) ds dq ∗
          "Hd" ∷ ownSlice ds s.Data' dq ∗
            "HM" ∷
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Metadata" p) pm
                  dq ∗
              "Hm" ∷ smPts pm dq s.Metadata' ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.Snapshot p uf)

theorem csOptA_persistent (p : Loc) (c : ConfStateM) : Persistent (csOptA p DFrac.discard c)

theorem ownSnapW_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : SnapshotM) :
    ownSnapW p dq s ⊢ |==> ∃ pm pc, ⌜pm ≠ null ∧ pc ≠ null⌝ ∗ ownSnapM p DFrac.discard s ∗
    typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Metadata" p) pm DFrac.discard ∗ typedPointsto
    (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"ConfState" pm) pc DFrac.discard ∗ csOptA pc
    DFrac.discard s.Metadata'.ConfState'

def smPtsW (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ pc pi pt uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null ∧ pc ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HC" ∷
            typedPointsto
              (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"ConfState" p) pc
              dq ∗
          "Hc" ∷ csOptA pc dq md.ConfState' ∗
            "HI" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"Index" p) pi dq ∗
              "#cI" ∷ cellRO pi md.Index' ∗
                "HT" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.SnapshotMetadata go!"Term" p) pt dq ∗
                  "#cT" ∷ cellRO pt md.Term' ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.SnapshotMetadata p uf)

theorem smPts_persistent (p : Loc) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) : Persistent (smPts p DFrac.discard md)

theorem entsBig_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] : ⊢ [∗list] l;e ∈ [];[], entRO l e

theorem ownSnapW_of_struct [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (v : raftpb.Snapshot) (s :
    SnapshotM) (E : CoPset) (Hu : v.unknownFields' = slice.nil) : typedPointsto p v (DFrac.own 1) ∗
    ownSlice v.Data' s.Data' (DFrac.own 1) ∗ smPtsW v.Metadata' (DFrac.own 1) s.Metadata' ⊢ |={E}=>
    ownSnapW p (DFrac.own 1) s

theorem entsBig_subslice [package_sem : Assumptions] (lo hi : Nat) (ls : List Loc) (es : List
    EntryM) : ([∗list] l;e ∈ ls;es, entRO l e) ⊢ [∗list] l;e ∈ subslice lo hi ls;subslice lo hi es,
    entRO l e

theorem csOpt_persistent (p : Loc) (c : ConfStateM) : Persistent (csOpt p DFrac.discard c)

theorem entsPts_nil [package_sem : Assumptions] (dq : DFrac) : ⊢ entsPts slice.nil dq []

theorem ownSnapM_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : SnapshotM) :
    ownSnapM p dq s ⊢ |==> ownSnapM p DFrac.discard s

theorem csPts_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) (al :
    Bool) : csPts p dq c al ⊢ |==> csPts p DFrac.discard c al

theorem entsBig_lookup [package_sem : Assumptions] (ls : List Loc) (es : List EntryM) (i : Nat) (e :
    EntryM) (He : es[i]? = some e) : ([∗list] l;e ∈ ls;es, entRO l e) ⊢ ∃ l, ⌜ls[i]? = some l⌝ ∗
    entRO l e

def entsRO (s : GoSlice) (es : List EntryM) : IProp GF :=
  entsPts s DFrac.discard es

theorem smPts_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) :
    smPts p dq md ⊢ |==> smPts p DFrac.discard md

theorem entsBig_app [package_sem : Assumptions] (ls1 ls2 : List Loc) (es1 es2 : List EntryM) :
    (([∗list] l;e ∈ ls1;es1, entRO l e) ∗ [∗list] l;e ∈ ls2;es2, entRO l e) ⊢ [∗list] l;e ∈ ls1 ++
    ls2;es1 ++ es2, entRO l e

theorem entsPts_len [package_sem : Assumptions] (s : GoSlice) (dq : DFrac) (es : List EntryM) :
    entsPts s dq es ⊢ ⌜es.length = sint.nat s.len ∧ 0 ≤ sint.Z s.len⌝

theorem hsOpt_null [package_sem : Assumptions] : ⊢ hsOpt null { Term' := W64 0, Vote' := W64 0,
    Commit' := W64 0 }

theorem hsOpt_agree [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (h1 h2 : HardStateM) : hsOpt p h1 ∗ hsOpt
    p h2 ⊢ ⌜h1 = h2⌝

theorem csOptA_persist [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (c : ConfStateM) : csOptA
    p dq c ⊢ |==> csOptA p DFrac.discard c

def ownSnapW (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : SnapshotM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(∃ ds pm uf,
      "%Hnn" ∷ ⌜p ≠ null⌝ ∗
        "HD" ∷ typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Data" p) ds dq ∗
          "Hd" ∷ ownSlice ds s.Data' dq ∗
            "HM" ∷
                typedPointsto (structFieldRef raftpb.Snapshot go!"Metadata" p) pm
                  dq ∗
              "Hm" ∷ smPtsW pm dq s.Metadata' ∗ "#Hpb" ∷ pbMsg raftpb.Snapshot p uf)

theorem smPtsW_smPts [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) :
    smPtsW p dq md ⊢ smPts p dq md

theorem smOpt_persistent (p : Loc) (md : SnapshotMetadataM) : Persistent (smOpt p DFrac.discard md)

theorem entsBig_length [package_sem : Assumptions] (ls : List Loc) (es : List EntryM) : ([∗list] l;e
    ∈ ls;es, entRO l e) ⊢ ⌜ls.length = es.length⌝

theorem hsOpt_persistent (p : Loc) (hs : HardStateM) : Persistent (hsOpt p hs)

theorem ownSnapE_weaken [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : SnapshotM) :
    ownSnapE p dq s ⊢ ownSnapM p dq s

theorem ownSnapW_E [package_sem : Assumptions] (p : Loc) (dq : DFrac) (s : SnapshotM) : ownSnapW p
    dq s ⊢ ownSnapE p dq s

def hsOpt (p : Loc) (hs : HardStateM) : IProp GF :=
  iprop(⌜p = null ∧ hs = { Term' := W64 0, Vote' := W64 0, Commit' := W64 0 }⌝ ∨ hsRO p hs)

theorem ownSnapM_persistent (p : Loc) (s : SnapshotM) : Persistent (ownSnapM p DFrac.discard s)
